# NSKT Global

> > NSKT Global is a leading international consulting firm delivering assurance, advisory, taxation, and technology solutions across the Middle East, Americas, and Asia.

With over 10 years of experience, NSKT Global serves clients across the UAE, USA, and India with comprehensive business consulting, financial services, and digital transformation expertise. The firm specializes in regulatory compliance, risk management, and enterprise solutions for businesses of all sizes.
